purpose: Bind B168 exact proof, B169 live-base evidence and B170 fixed-template validation to one SHA256 within 300 seconds

bindings.a1: B168 audit PASS and immutable proof digest
bindings.b1: B169 base-commit SHA, repo name, proposal digest, fresh base CI evidence
bindings.c1: B170 local fixed-template pass, cleanup, same proposal digest

limitations: Base CI is not proposed patch CI
Local template checks do not prove integration correctness
Passing B171 does not establish owner authorization
Hash chain only detects internal evidence changes, not source authenticity
